title: Cap of Wrath

sources.title: Last Stand
markers: | summary = '''Last Stand''' is a passive feature that increases your damage when you are severely wounded.

summary: During combat, start a turn at half HP or lower to gain Wrath.

fields.Wrath: At the start of your turn in combat at half HP or less, gain 1 turn of Wrath. The tooltip says 2 turns, but the pinned rule reports 1. Wrath adds 1 melee weapon damage per remaining turn, stacking up to 7.
fields.Base value: 640 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Expanded the card from the pinned item and linked gameplay evidence.
